inputs.objective: Improve contribution while protecting accepted pickup promises.

result.objective: Fixed score = modeled contribution minus 0.60 per late minute and 0.08 per holding minute. Preserve existing-order service. Held-out cases are unavailable.

qualification.explanation: Default retained: candidate did not meet every independent score/service gate.
qualification.evaluation_scope: Six held-out modeled cases, not a restaurant pilot
